title: Tool policy
description: Deny-by-default, deny-wins, fail-closed. This layer is defence in depth and is not the authority: the read-only guarantee is the RBAC grant that Azure Resource Manager enforces (SEC-001). The policy is declared here and is not framework-enforced, so its limits are verified by the post-deployment posture check rather than asserted locally (FR-53). It names capability classes, never the tool identifiers of a pinned runtime version.

defaultDecision.description: Pinned to deny. A capability absent from the allow list is denied because nothing granted it, not because a rule caught it. This is why an unrecognised capability cannot arrive permitted.

conflictResolution.description: Pinned. Where an allow and a deny both match, deny takes effect. Stated explicitly because the opposite convention exists elsewhere and a silent difference here would be a permission escalation.

onEvaluationFailure.description: Pinned to deny. A policy that cannot be evaluated must not resolve to permitted. Fail-open is inexpressible rather than discouraged.

allowedCapabilityClasses.description: Required, and required even when empty. An empty list denies everything and says so; an absent list would be read as 'unrestricted' by anything that treats absence as a wildcard (NEG-D).

denyRules.description: Every one of the seven categories FR-52 names must carry an explicit deny rule. minItems together with uniqueItems and a seven-member enumeration is what forces all seven to be present: with fewer than seven distinct members the instance cannot satisfy both constraints. Explicit denial is redundant against defaultDecision on purpose, so that removing the allow list does not quietly remove the prohibition.

executionLimits.description: All four limits FR-53 enumerates. Declared, not framework-enforced: enforcement belongs to the agent runtime, and the framework does not assert what it cannot observe. The posture check reports the limits the runtime actually holds and fails on a mismatch.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Constrained so an identifier cannot carry arbitrary text, and English by construction (FR-03, CON-01).

capabilityClass.description: The same closed set the agent definition uses. Read-shaped only. Arbitrary query construction has no class here, which is how it is denied structurally rather than filtered at run time (NEG-C).

category.description: The seven categories FR-52 enumerates. A closed enumeration, so a deny rule cannot be written for an eighth category that no negative test covers, and the seven cannot be renamed apart from the tests that assert them.

justification.description: Why the category is denied. Required so the policy remains reviewable by someone who did not write it.
